newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Placer Dome falls in N.Y.. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Placer Dome falls in N.Y.. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]

text.p: Canadian mining company Placer Dome Inc fell (corrects from "rose") in heavy trade on Thursday to highlight the market in foreign shares and American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Most foreign shares followed the Dow industrials and Nasdaq composite index slightly higher. Advancers led decliners by 271 to 255 among 807 ADRs, and volume was 59 million shares in early afternoon.
"Europe is up strong and ADRs have followed," a trader said.
Placer Dome was down (corrects from "up") 7/8 to 19-7/8 after the company announced Australia's Highlands Gold Ltd would recommend shareholders accept Placer's takeover offer.
Volume was 1.5 million shares, well above Placer's normal daily level of 873,000 shares.
